newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse ends 0.13 pct lower, volume up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse ends 0.13 pct lower, volume up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed down by 0.13 percent despite higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 446.34 points, down from 446.93 on Monday.
Total volume was 1.03 million dinars against 862,241 dinars over the previous session.
Banque du Sud fell 1.39 dinar to 10.65 dinars with 33,657 shares changing hands. Banque Nationale Agricole was down 0.52 dinar to 18.53 dinars.
Palm Beach Hotels eased 0.38 dinar to 9.38 dinars.
Banque de Tunisie et des Emirats d'Investissement edged lower 0.2 dinar to 22 dinars. Societe Tunisienne de Banque declined 0.14 dinar to 12.5 dinars.
Chemical firm Alkimia was up 0.48 dinar to 41 dinars. Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel rose 0.2 dinar to 8.19 dinars.
